records.text: I think that's also really beautiful. Margaret (commenter; full identity unverified) writes, Candace (Candace Owens), your one-year memorial to Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was exactly what he would have loved. It was a love that he deserved one year ago at his public funeral.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
